scripts.text:
[Zonda Employee]
Welcome.
Our team is always working to exceed your expectations regarding quality of service.
Please choose your destination.

[宗达员工]
欢迎光临。
我们不断提升服务品质，力求超越您的期待。
请选择目的地。
